user.title: Add Thermex range hood
user.description: Enter the hood's Bluetooth address. The hood only advertises briefly after a power cycle, so it usually cannot be discovered automatically. You can find the address with `bluetoothctl scan le` shortly after switching the hood's power off and on again.

confirm.title: Add Thermex range hood
confirm.description: Set up the hood found at {address}?

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, make sure no phone is connected to the hood, and that the hood is in range of Home Assistant or a Bluetooth proxy.

abort.already_configured: This hood is already set up.
